title: Subset-count reductions and multiset counting extensions

problemStatement.plain: Clarify the Lean-supported reductions around ordinary subset counting and distinct submultiset counting. The core track proves the powerset cardinality theorem, the binomial-coefficient sum interpretation, and the product formula for submultisets with repeated elements.
whyMatters: Subset counting is the base case for many finite-combinatorics reductions.
The multiset product formula records the exact correction needed when elements have multiplicity.
All declared Lean support is zero-axiom and zero-sorry, making this a clean metadata landing for completed formal content.

proven: `card_powerset_eq_two_pow` proves that a finite set has exactly `2 ^ card` subsets.
`sum_choose_eq_two_pow` gives the binomial-coefficient count of all subsets by size.
`card_distinctSubMultisets` proves the distinct-submultiset product formula `prod (count a + 1)`.
open: The remaining mathematical question is classificatory: which external counting problems reduce canonically to these subset or multiset templates?
knownResults.goal: Use the proved powerset and multiset-counting lemmas as a reliable reduction library for future finite-counting entries.
